A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RankCLIP work, and their text, equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison. v2 Appendices A and B largely reproduce material from v1 Sections 3.1 and 4.1.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification, retrieval, distribution-shift, ablation and embedding-analysis results from models pretrained on CC3M.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Tables 1–6 and the data-size and modality-gap plots.

M1.justification: The encoders, Plackett–Luce ranking formulation, decaying factor and combined contrastive/in-modal/cross-modal loss remain equivalent. v2's diagram and rewritten explanations describe the existing method.

E1.justification: Both versions retain CC3M pretraining, CIFAR/ImageNet classification, four shifted ImageNet benchmarks, eleven linear-probing datasets, and Flickr30K/MSCOCO retrieval. No evaluated dataset or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: CLIP and ALIP remain the evaluated baselines in the corresponding benchmark tables. The component variants and plotted comparators are retained. Newly discussed EqSim is not evaluated.

E3.justification: The documented training settings, evaluation metrics, linear-probing procedure and data-size ablation settings are retained. v2 omits retrieval split details without reporting a replacement protocol; this reduces documentation rather than establishing an experimental change.

E4.justification: Component ablations, data-size scaling, distribution-shift tests, the 250-pair modality-gap visualization, and alignment/uniformity analysis are retained. v1 Figures 2–3 correspond to v2 Figures 3–4.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The point-result reporting and descriptive plots remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–6 and the empirical plots are retained. However, Section 4.4 changes the qualitative finding from outperforming CLIP 'in most domains' to 'consistently outperforms CLIP.' The unchanged Aircraft accuracies, 24.99% versus CLIP's 26.10%, contradict this broader summary.

T1.justification: The ranking probabilities, loss definitions and alignment/uniformity formulas remain mathematically equivalent. CLIP preliminaries move to Appendix A; notation changes and equation splitting introduce no new derivation, assumption or proof.

C1.justification: Both versions claim that in-modal and cross-modal ranking consistency exploits many-to-many relationships and improves downstream performance without additional data or computational resources. v2 emphasizes listwise optimization more explicitly, but that contribution was already stated in v1.

C2.justification: v2 adds explicit limitations concerning computational constraints on baseline breadth and larger-scale pretraining. Section 4.5 removes v1's explanations involving five captions per image, ALIP's synthetic-caption advantage and possible ResNet-50 capacity limitations.

D1.justification: v2 removes the Karpathy split specification and the Flickr30K/MSCOCO test-set sizes of 1,000/5,000 from Section 4.5. Implementation, hardware, hyperparameters and code-access statements are otherwise retained, mainly through relocation to Appendix B.

R1.justification: v2 adds EqSim discussion but removes the Learning-to-Rank subsection, including ListNet/ListMLE references and the explicit statement that RankCLIP incorporates ListMLE. BASIC and the retrieval-split reference also disappear. Plackett–Luce attribution and the principal vision-language positioning remain.

P1.justification: Substantial rewriting and condensation affect the abstract, introduction, related work, method explanations and experimental discussion. The methodology hierarchy is reorganized, cross-modal discussion precedes in-modal discussion, and preliminaries and training details move into appendices.

P2.justification: v2 adds a substantial method schematic as Figure 2 and moves Figure 1 from a full-width display to a much smaller first-page column display. The document template, typography, captions, figure sizing and table presentation are revised throughout.

improvement.justification: The new method schematic, clearer organization and explicit limitations improve accessibility and qualification. However, v2 loses retrieval split/test-size documentation and explicit ListMLE attribution, while its broader linear-probing summary conflicts with unchanged Table 3. These material gains and losses leave the net quality direction uncertain.
